AllocateAnycastEipAddress.title: AllocateAnycastEipAddress
AllocateAnycastEipAddress.summary: The AllocateAnycastEipAddress operation creates an Anycast EIP instance.

AssociateAnycastEipAddress.title: AssociateAnycastEipAddress
AssociateAnycastEipAddress.summary: Associates an Anycast EIP with a specified backend cloud resource.

ChangeResourceGroup.title: Modify the resource group of an anycastEipAddress instance
ChangeResourceGroup.summary: Modifies the resource group to which an AnycastEipAddress instance belongs.

DescribeAnycastEipAddress.title: DescribeAnycastEipAddress
DescribeAnycastEipAddress.summary: Queries the details of a specified Anycast EIP instance, including its status, peak bandwidth, and associated cloud resources.

DescribeAnycastPopLocations.title: DescribeAnycastPopLocations
DescribeAnycastPopLocations.summary: Queries the access points in a specified access area.

DescribeAnycastServerRegions.title: DescribeAnycastServerRegions
DescribeAnycastServerRegions.summary: Queries the regions where backend services can be attached to an Anycast EIP.

ListAnycastEipAddresses.title: ListAnycastEipAddresses
ListAnycastEipAddresses.summary: Queries the details of Anycast EIPs in a specified access area, including their status, peak bandwidth, and information about bound cloud resources.

ListTagResources.title: Query tags bound to instances
ListTagResources.summary: Queries the tags that are bound to Anycast elastic IP addresses (Anycast EIPs) by calling the ListTagResources operation.

ModifyAnycastEipAddressAttribute.title: ModifyAnycastEipAddressAttribute
ModifyAnycastEipAddressAttribute.summary: Changes the name and description of an Anycast EIP instance.

ModifyAnycastEipAddressSpec.title: ModifyAnycastEipAddressSpec
ModifyAnycastEipAddressSpec.summary: Modifies the bandwidth of an Anycast EIP instance.

TagResources.title: TagResources
TagResources.summary: Creates and attaches tags to specified resources.

UnassociateAnycastEipAddress.title: UnassociateAnycastEipAddress
UnassociateAnycastEipAddress.summary: Disassociates an Anycast EIP from an endpoint.

UntagResources.title: UntagResources
UntagResources.summary: Detaches tags from Anycast EIPs in a batch.

UpdateAnycastEipAddressAssociations.title: UpdateAnycastEipAddressAssociations
UpdateAnycastEipAddressAssociations.summary: If an Anycast EIP instance is associated with backend resources in multiple regions, you can modify the mappings between access points and origin servers. You can call the UpdateAnycastEipAddressAssociations operation to add or remove access points for a specified origin server, which is an associated cloud resource instance.
